remarks: This light filled fully renovated 2 bedroom condo is a must see. The eat-in kitchen has been remodeled featuring stainless appliances, new cabinets, tile floor and granite counters. There is also a large hall closet with plenty of storage pantry space. Beautiful hardwood floors and freshly painted-move in ready.  Heat, hot water and cooking gas are included. Walking distance to downtown Stamford. Situated on the second floor, this handsome red brick mid-rise building, complete with lobby entrance and elevators. There is a large Coin-op laundry room in the basement. This unit has a parking space in the rear lot in a prime location. Enjoy all that Stamford has including beaches, parks, shopping, dining, medical facilities and easy access to Metro North Train.
